title: Hearty Roasted Dutch Lettuce Casserole
description: A shojin-friendly Dutch dish featuring roasted lettuce in a glassy jelly sauce, perfect for meal prep. This casserole is a unique and delicious twist on traditional Dutch cuisine.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cut the Dutch lettuce into large pieces and roast in the oven for 20 minutes, or until slightly caramelized.
In a large pan, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the onion and garlic until softened.
Add the mushrooms to the pan and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown.
In a small bowl, whisk together the vegetable broth, agar agar powder, and nutritional yeast.
Pour the broth mixture over the mushrooms and onion, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer for 10 minutes, or until the sauce has thickened into a glassy jelly.
In a large casserole dish, combine the roasted lettuce and jelly sauce.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Broil the casserole in the oven for 5 minutes, or until the top is lightly browned.
